BiblicalUsage: tsᵉphardêaʻ stands behind the English phrase a frog. In Exodus 8:2, I will smite all thy borders with frogs, and it appears again in Psalms 78:45.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that God put tsᵉphardêaʻ exactly where it is, and I trust His placing of it.
